# Polyhedral Dice

Free 3D polyhedral dice set.

Created by TSE-WEI-CHEN (Gary).

Includes D4, D6, D8, D10, percentile D10, D12, and D20.

- Blender source files
- Optimized glTF models
- PBR textures
